verdict.rationale: uv fully supports installing Python packages and tools via uv add, uv pip, uv tool install/uvx, all of which draw on the standard Python package ecosystem (PyPI) and are corroborated by extensive community use for real-world packages like torch, ruff, and pycowsay, showing it can fetch a huge range of actively maintained packages quickly and reliably. missing for 10: explicit mention of PyPI/registry scale or freshness, and independent benchmarking of registry breadth vs pip/conda.
